svg.title: The Tesseract NPU core
svg.desc: Stylised die of tsr_core: four MVM clusters of 128 MACs at the corners, each next to its own DDR4 channel and memory arbiter; the 4 MiB SPM in the centre with the x broadcast / y gather to the clusters; DMA, QACT and the CSR block on the v1 core; the v2 additions drawn dashed: control core (Ibex RV32IMC, ITCM and DTCM), debug module, issue path with unit queues, vector unit, KVST in the DMA, even and odd SPM banks. The host reaches the CSR port over PCIe and XRT with a launch queue and a completion ring. One cluster is opened up: weight streamer, unpack, activation buffer, 128 MAC lanes with planned attention modes, fp accumulate and tree16.
